dict.string: NexgenSocial uses your camera for video calls, recording reels, and taking photos to post.
NexgenSocial uses your microphone for voice and video calls, and for recording reels with sound.
NexgenSocial needs access to your photos so you can share them in posts, messages, and marketplace listings.
NexgenSocial saves photos and videos you download to your photo library.
NexgenSocial uses your location only when you tap "use my current location" to save a place you have visited. It never tracks you in the background.
NexgenSocial can check which of your contacts are already here, so you can find them. Contacts are matched and not stored.
